name: figures-per-criterion
text: Context figures researched per criterion (figures are about the outlet, program, event or market, not the founder):

1 awards: applicants or entrants; selection rate; scope. 2 membership: acceptance rate; who reviews admission; size. 3 published material: readership (circulation, monthly unique visitors, podcast downloads); audience; outlet type. 4 judging: submissions judged; participants; organizer standing. 5 contributions: stars, forks, dependents, downloads, citations. 6 scholarly: acceptance rate; impact measure; citations; talk attendance. 7 critical role: funding, investors, press, rankings. 8 remuneration: 90th-percentile wage for the job code and location; equity valuation basis.
